   HOMŒOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA

         by William BOERICKE, M.D.

          Presented by Médi-T



           VINCA MINOR

         Lesser Periwinkle


A remedy for skin affections, eczema, and especially plica polonica; also
        for hæmorrhages and diphtheria.



Head.--  Tearing pain in vertex, ringing and whistling in ears.
        Whirling vertigo, with flickering before eyes.   Spots on scalp,
        oozing moisture, matting hair together. Corrosive itching of scalp  . Bald spots.   Plica polonica  . Irresistible desire to scratch.



Nose.--  Tip gets red easily. Moist eruption on septum. Stoppage
        of one nostril.   Sores in nose  . Seborrhœa upper lip and
        base of nose.



Throat.--  Difficult swallowing. Ulcers. Frequent hawking.   Diphtheria  .



Female.--  Excessive menstruation with great weakness.   Passive uterine hæmorrhages   (  Ust;
        Trill; Secale  ). Menorrhagia; continuous flow, particularly at climacteric (  Lach  ). Hæmorrhages from fibroids.



Skin.--  Corrosive itching.   Great
        sensitiveness of skin, with redness and soreness   from slight rubbing. Eczema of
        head and face; pustules, itching, burning, and offensive odor. Hair matted together.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Oleand; Staph  .



Dose.--  First to third potency.
